main.description: Notify the AppView that the requester has seen its private notifications up to seenAt. The stored time never moves back, and a time in the future is taken as now. Separate from app.bsky.notification.updateSeen. Requires auth by a ready community member.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: seenAt is missing or not a datetime.

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.description: The caller's account indexing is still in progress.
